messages:
sarah: FYI — Acme POC is asking for a 35% discount + 12mo commit. They want Dedicated and private network. Need deal desk routing and any CPQ special-terms template we should use. Close window is end of week, can we fast-track?

michael_dd: Need a few details before routing: what's the ARR+ACV on the opp, sku list, and is there an MSA in flight? Also: is the 35% off list or off our committed pricing?

sarah: ARR ~ $420k ARR (pro-rated first year ~ $350k). SKUs: redwood-hosted-dedicated (x2), pvt-network-addon. MSA is in legal review (submitted yesterday). Discount is off list.

jenn_salesops: Ok — for >30% discounts we require Deal Desk approval + Director signoff. Turnaround SLA: standard 24h first-response, 48h final decision. If legal has MSA in progress we can attach provisional special terms. Use our CPQ template: /templates/dealdesk/special_terms_poc_v2.docx (internal).

oli_se: Heads-up on the POC side: customer will run a security questionnaire and needs a Data Processing Addendum + KMS integration notes. That may add time. Recommend ST code ST-POC-EXP for expedited review if sales commits to a Q3 close.

michael_dd: To route cleanly, update the Opportunity fields in SF:
```
Opportunity.Stage = "Contract Review"
Opportunity.Expected_Close_Date = "2024-09-29"
Opportunity.Special_Terms_Code__c = "ST-POC-EXP"
Opportunity.Deal_Desk_Priority__c = "Expedite"
CPQ__Discount_Approval_Level__c = "Director"
```
Also attach the legal intake PDF and the MSA PR link. I'll create the deal desk ticket once those are attached.

sarah: I attached the intake PDF and the signed LOI to the opp. Marking priority = Expedite. Can you also include a line-item note: "Private deployment: customer-managed VPC, HSM KMS requirement"?

jenn_salesops: Done — I updated the CPQ routing rules to include clause: if Special_Terms_Code__c starts with "ST-POC" route to DealDesk > Director > ProductLegal sequentially. I also enabled an override flag for AE if "Expedite" priority is set (audit trail required).

michael_dd: Perfect. I'll kick off the approval ticket now and ping Director @maria_dd for signoff. If Maria is OOO we fall back to @tim_ops. Expect first-response within 6 hours due to expedite. :thumbsup:

oli_se: I'll prep the security questionnaire answers and post the short runbook for the Dedicated POC (network ports, expected bandwidth, kv-cache sizing). Sharing in #eng-ml once ready.

sarah: Thanks all — please post signoff here when done. If we get Director approval today we can get the customer a formal quote by EOD. :fire:
